identification.note: This is a bounded digest annex declared at docs/team/M0-03/allowlist.json#/writeClosure and docs/team/M0-03/execution-profile.json#/writeClosure. It is NOT a third designated output, it carries no policy content, no allowlist row, no gate verdict and no acceptance claim: its only values are the two artifacts' SHA-256 file-byte digests and the commands that reproduce them. It exists because a file cannot embed the digest of its own bytes, so without a durable location inside the declared write scope the digest-binding requirement could only be met from the authoring report's return payload. Not accepted, not final, not complete; a human PM verifies it.

deviationEscalation.statement: This annex is a third file beyond the two designated outputs that frozen criteria section 6 names. It declares that at /identification/notADesignatedOutput true and repeats it at docs/team/M0-03/allowlist.json#/writeClosure/designatedOutputDeviation and docs/team/M0-03/execution-profile.json#/writeClosure/designatedOutputDeviation.
deviationEscalation.selfExemption: none: under G0 a candidate may not judge its own compliance, so the deviation is escalated, not exempted.
deviationEscalation.disposition: PM must confirm the third file, reject it and have the candidate reworked to two outputs, or amend the frozen designated-output sentence.

purpose: Durable, recomputable binding between the two designated M0-03 candidate artifacts and their exact bytes, inside the declared write scope docs/team/M0-03/ (frozen criteria section 6).

noPermissionStatement: Even if the digests match, this annex grants no install, Pi/MCP/model/network/Unity, restricted-source, publication, merge, product or safety permission, and no policy PASS.
